notes.coq_c5_evidence: Yeast genetics and homolog inference; native Yarrowia enzymatic coupling and NADH preference unverified. AND means serial electron transfer, not a stable heterotrimer.
notes.coq_c5_roles: YALI1A08781g: COQ6-family C5 hydroxylase; YALI1B03314g: YAH1-like ferredoxin; YALI1B19490g: ARH1-like ferredoxin reductase. Native established symbols unverified.
notes.coq_c5_previous_representation: R39: cytosolic m108 + 0.5 m109 to m10 + m110; empty GPR; bounds 0..1000. Replaced in this candidate; no parallel donor-free C5 reaction added.
notes.coq_c5_cofactor_limit: NADH is a provisional permitted donor based on yeast ARH1 heterologous-carrier assay; NADPH is also plausible. Existing NADP/NADPH formula-charge mismatch prevents a balanced NADPH variant without wider cofactor curation; no cofactor species changed.
notes.coq_c5_structure: 基于 AlphaFold 预测的功能候选；复用精确序列已有单体预测，不证明供电子配对或原生定位。
notes.coq_c5_limits: Provisional mitochondrial localization; no explicit ferredoxin pool, FAD turnover or Fe-S assembly model. R19 chemistry and COQ8 reaction-level dependence remain unresolved; no growth essentiality validation.
notes.coq_c5_legacy_note_context: The preserved curated_coq9_chemistry note describes the earlier C45 identity repair only. This later C5 hypothesis changes R39 stoichiometry, compartment and GPR as stated above; bounds and demand stay unchanged.
